noteEn: These are the days of {ko:소한}. Next comes {ko:대한} on 20 January. Then {ko:입춘}, the start of spring, comes on 4 February.

sources.quoteOrLocator: "이십사절기의 하나. 대한(大寒)과 우수(雨水) 사이에 들며, 이때부터 봄이 시작된다고 한다. 양력으로는 2월 4일경이다."

notes: Pass 1, author (content-skill): note, items and sources written from the cited pages, all accessed 2026-10-30; every claim is quoted in quoteOrLocator.

Pass 2, three checkers. Language: romanization of every item and token is the F-CNT-002 converter's output (checked by the build); polite 해요 register in the ko text; Pre-A1 English. Culture and facts: each claim matched to an allowlisted source (§6.6) with the §5.1 conventions. All three dates from the KASI 2027 table; 'the start of spring' is NIKL's 입춘 entry (이때부터 봄이 시작된다고 한다). No weather claim is made. Learning design: 5 items, at most 8 new (lesson-new-load), no two items of the drop said alike (dictation-unambiguous), no %, score, age word, speaking line or emoji (review-copy).

Pass 3, reviser and third pass: fixes of pass 2 applied (wording kept plain, every holiday and term date re-read against the KASI table), es and ko overlays re-read against the English; no copy claims native-speaker or expert review.
